info.name: Sistema ERP - Complete API
info.description: Colección completa del Sistema ERP con todos los módulos: Auth, Products, Sales, Purchase, Users, Accounting

graphql.query:
query GetProducts {
  products(skip: 0, take: 20, search: "", category: "") {
    id
    name
    sku
    description
    price
    cost
    stock
    minStock
    category
    isActive
    createdAt
    updatedAt
  }
}

query GetSalesOrders {
  salesOrders(skip: 0, take: 20) {
    id
    orderNumber
    customerName
    userName
    status
    subtotal
    taxAmount
    totalAmount
    orderDate
    deliveryDate
    notes
    items {
      id
      productName
      quantity
      unitPrice
      totalPrice
    }
  }
}

query GetSalesOrder {
  salesOrder(id: 1) {
    id
    orderNumber
    customerName
    userName
    status
    subtotal
    taxAmount
    totalAmount
    orderDate
    deliveryDate
    notes
    items {
      productName
      quantity
      unitPrice
      totalPrice
    }
  }
}

query GetPurchaseOrders {
  purchaseOrders(skip: 0, take: 20) {
    id
    orderNumber
    supplierName
    userName
    status
    subtotal
    taxAmount
    totalAmount
    orderDate

    receivedDate

    items {
